title.narrative: Fortalecimento dos Sistemas Agroalimentares das Famílias - 2a fase

description.narrative: The Strengthening of agri-food systems of families - 2nd Phase or Strengthening of agri-food systems for families, phase 2 project will be implemented in the districts of Changara and Cahora Bassa in Tete Province targeting about 2.885 rightsholders from which 1.578 women, members of a total of 30 associations suported by UPCT. The project's main objectives is to Increase the resilience of the small holder farms to deal with climate change impacts, Improve food and nutritional security, Stimulate rural entrepreneurship, and Strengthening the role of local leadership and women's leagues as agents of change To achieve the above-mentioned objectives, the project will work toward strengthen families, capacity to use sustainable agri-food systems and providing alternative livelihoods, beyond reliance solely on agricultural production activities. members of associations will receive training in agro-processing, business management, and post-harvest practices, environmental sustainability, and nutrition, including guidance on healthy eating habits and financial literacy. ect will encourage and support smallholders farmers to promote villages loans and saving groups and engage them in market-oriented production technologies.
